title: Early Morning Sunwatch
text:
🌅 Early Morning Sunwatch — November 24, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B1.4)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B2.6 (Peaked November 24, 2026 at 00:41 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 304 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.67)

A photon made in the Sun's core can take thousands of years to work its way to the surface. 🌞🌎

Sunny sees a large central coronal hole, along with a few small sunspots and bright active regions.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 304 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
